capabilities.scope_policy_title: What Apollia can do with this account
capabilities.scope_policy_body_google: Apollia v0.1.0 uses free Google permissions only. Your agents can: send emails and prepare drafts, read and write your calendar, create and edit Drive, Sheets, Docs and Slides files, manage your tasks, create forms, and browse YouTube. On Drive, they work inside the Apollia folder (configurable path) and any folder you designate via the Google picker (Settings → Integrations → "Add via Google"). What they do not do by default: read your whole inbox, search your emails, or browse your entire Drive without you designating the relevant areas. To go further, **Expert Mode** (below) lets you connect your own Google app with extended permissions.
capabilities.scope_policy_body_microsoft: On Microsoft, your agents can search and read your Outlook mail, send and reply, list and manage your Outlook calendar, and search, read and download your OneDrive files. Unlike Google, reading the inbox needs no advanced permission. Writing to OneDrive will come later (read-only for now).

entries.gmail_read_inbox_detail: Reading and searching the inbox needs an advanced Google permission that is not included by default. Available via Expert Mode (your own Google app).
entries.gdrive_workspace_list: List files Apollia created in the folder you chose
entries.gdrive_workspace_read: Read a file Apollia previously wrote
entries.gdrive_workspace_write: Create or replace a file (requires approval)
entries.gdrive_workspace_share: Share an Apollia-created file with someone (requires approval)
entries.gdrive_workspace_detail: Apollia works in (1) the Apollia root folder chosen at connection time (default Drive/Apollia/) and (2) any folder you designate via the Google picker. Your other files stay invisible to it.
entries.gdrive_picker: Designate any Drive folder via the Google picker
entries.gdrive_picker_detail: "Add via Google" button in Settings → Integrations: you designate a folder (including your Drive root), and Apollia gains access to it and its contents. No advanced permission required.
entries.gdrive_full: Auto-list every Drive file (without designating anything first)
entries.gdrive_full_detail: Auto-listing your entire Drive needs an advanced Google permission, available in Expert Mode. The Google picker above covers most needs without it.
entries.gdrive_write_anywhere: Write or edit files without designating them first
entries.gdrive_write_anywhere_detail: Writing anywhere without designating a folder needs an advanced Google permission (Expert Mode). In practice, designate your folders via the picker: Apollia can then write inside them normally.
entries.gsheets_read_values: Read cells from a Sheet (A1 notation)
entries.gsheets_write_values: Write/append rows in a Sheet (requires approval)
entries.gsheets_detail: Your agents create and edit Google Sheets. Included in the free tier.
entries.gdocs_read_text: Read the plain-text content of a Doc
entries.gdocs_append_text: Append text to the end of a Doc (requires approval)
entries.gdocs_detail: Your agents create and edit Google Docs. Included in the free tier.
entries.gslides_create: Create a Google Slides deck (requires approval)
entries.gslides_append_slide: Append a slide with a text block (requires approval)
entries.gslides_detail: Deck creation for v0.1; fine editing (layout, images, etc.) will come later. Included in the free tier.
entries.gtasks_list: List your tasks and task lists
entries.gtasks_complete: Mark a task as completed (requires approval)
entries.gtasks_detail: Full Google Tasks access: all your lists and tasks.
entries.gforms_detail: Form creation for v0.1 (question editing coming later). Included in the free tier.
entries.youtube_video_details: Fetch a video's metadata (views, duration, description)
entries.youtube_detail: Read-only YouTube: search and metadata. No channel management, no uploads.
entries.onedrive_read: Read and download a OneDrive file
entries.onedrive_detail: Read, search and download your OneDrive files.
entries.onedrive_write_detail: Writing to OneDrive is coming soon. For now, OneDrive is read-only.

capabilities.expert_mode_hint: Expert Mode (to extend permissions): 1) On console.cloud.google.com, create a project and an OAuth app of type "Desktop app". 2) On the consent screen, add the advanced permissions you want (Gmail read, full Drive, etc.). 3) Keep the app in "Testing" mode and add yourself as a test user. 4) Paste the Client ID + secret into Settings → Integrations → Expert Mode. Apollia switches to your app and your agents receive the extended permissions.

figma.auth_help:
Figma's remote MCP server (mcp.figma.com) is only open to clients on the Figma MCP Catalog (Claude.ai, Cursor, Windsurf, …). Apollia is on the waitlist - we'll switch to the remote endpoint as soon as we're approved.

In the meantime, this connector relies on Figma's LOCAL Dev Mode MCP server, bundled with Figma Desktop. Heads up: Dev Mode (and therefore its MCP server) requires a paid Figma plan (Professional or higher). If you're on the free plan, this connector won't work yet - wait for Apollia's approval on the remote Catalog.

If you have a paid plan:

1. Install Figma Desktop and sign in.
2. Open any file and toggle Dev Mode.
3. Enable “Dev Mode MCP Server” in Preferences.
4. Leave Figma Desktop running - your session provides identity, no OAuth needed.

help.subtitle: Get started with Apollia and find your way around the essentials.
help.intro: Apollia OS runs your AI agents locally, on your own machine, with your own models. The topics below cover the essentials to get up and running.
help.topic_model_body: Download a local GGUF model from the Model Hub, or connect an external backend, so Apollia and your agents can reason.
help.topic_chat_body: Talk to Apollia in natural language. Ask a question, delegate a task, or pick an agent to handle the work.
help.topic_stt_body: Enable the embedded speech-to-text engine (whisper.cpp) to dictate messages instead of typing.
help.topic_plan_body: For complex requests, Apollia can draft a step-by-step plan and let you review it before anything runs.
help.topic_profile_body: The information Apollia knows about you lives in your profile. Review it, edit it, or clear it anytime.
help.docs_desc: Step-by-step guides for every screen, on docs.apollia.fr.
help.hero_body: The help center walks you through installing a model, running your first agent, and reading the execution journal. This page is a map to it, not a copy.
help.shortcuts_desc: The full list of shortcuts, available offline inside the app.
help.community_desc: Ask questions and share your agents with other users on GitHub Discussions.
help.report_desc: Open an issue. Your diagnostics stay local unless you choose to attach them.
help.offline_body: Documentation and community links will open once the connection is back. The rest of the help page stays available.
help.faq_empty_body: No question matches "{query}". Try different words, or browse the full documentation.
help.faq_q_offline: Does Apollia work without an internet connection?
help.faq_a_offline: Yes. Inference, transcription and your data stay on the machine. Only the external links on this page and the OAuth connectors you explicitly enable leave your computer.
help.faq_a_model: In the ~/.apollia/models folder. The Model Hub shows the disk space used and lets you delete a model to free space.
help.faq_q_data: Do my conversations leave the machine?
help.faq_a_data: Never without an explicit action from you. Local-first is the first of Apollia's eight principles.
help.faq_q_shortcuts: What are the essential keyboard shortcuts?
help.faq_a_shortcuts: Open the Keyboard shortcuts page from the resources above for the full, offline list grouped by context.

about.subtitle: Version, links and licensing for this installation.
about.tagline: A sovereign runtime for autonomous AI agents, running locally without a cloud dependency.
about.docs_desc: Guides, references and the operator help center.
about.report_desc: Open an issue. Paste the diagnostic report above.
about.data_desc: Everything Apollia keeps sits in one directory on this machine: conversations, memory, models, configuration and the audit journal. Back it up or delete it like any other folder.
about.data_dir_unknown: Your home directory could not be resolved, so this path is unknown.
about.local_desc: No account, no cloud, no telemetry.
about.local_inference: Inference runs on an embedded llama-server. Model weights are files on your disk.
about.local_transcription: Voice dictation is transcribed by an embedded Whisper engine. No audio is uploaded.
about.local_memory: Conversations, agent memory and project context are stored in local SQLite databases.
about.local_audit: Every sensitive action is written to a local, tamper-evident audit journal you can export.
about.license_body: Apollia OS is free and open source, dual-licensed under either the MIT license or the Apache License 2.0, at your option.
about.build_desc: Useful for a bug report or a support request.
about.info_unavailable: System information could not be loaded. Make sure Apollia is running, then reopen this page.
about.copy_hint: One click copies the raw value.
about.updates_desc: Manual check only. No telemetry, no automatic background checks.
about.credits_desc: The open-source components embedded in Apollia. Thanks to their authors.
about.ethos: Everything runs on your machine. No account, no cloud, no telemetry. Your data never leaves the device without an explicit action from you.

observability.title: Observability
observability.subtitle: Control what is captured about agent execution. All captures are local - nothing is uploaded.
observability.capture_thoughts_desc: Persist the LLM 'thought' field at each ReAct turn.
observability.capture_tool_args_desc: Persist the args JSON of each tool invocation.
observability.capture_tool_outputs_desc: Persist the output JSON of each tool invocation.
observability.capture_agent_logs_desc: Persist debug/info/warn/error messages emitted by agents.
observability.retention_days_desc: How many days events are kept. The purge runs at startup. 0 means never purge.
observability.capture_section_desc: What is persisted in `runtime_events.db` at each agent turn. Disabling an item empties the matching elements in the timeline.
observability.privacy_section_desc: Extra debug logging. Distinct from trace capture: it writes to no database, it exposes the prompt in the TRACE log.
observability.truncation_section_desc: Maximum size kept per record. Beyond this, content is truncated to bound the database size.
observability.retention_section_desc: How long events are kept before automatic purge, consistent with the audit journal.
observability.debug_log_prompt_desc: Emits the full prompt to the log, at TRACE level. No visible effect on its own: the default filter is apollia=info, so the application also has to run with RUST_LOG=apollia=trace. Nothing is persisted to a database.
observability.max_input_bytes_desc: Maximum size of inputs kept. Default 32 KiB.
observability.max_output_bytes_desc: Maximum size of outputs kept. Default 32 KiB.
observability.max_tool_output_bytes_desc: Maximum size of a tool's standard output kept. Default 10 KiB.
observability.view_data_desc: Timeline, LLM costs and audit journal on the dedicated Observability page.
observability.editable_note: Edit the observability policy captured about agent execution. Everything stays local, nothing is uploaded.
observability.restart_note: Changes apply after restarting the app. The runtime does not reload this policy live.
observability.sensitive_confirm_message: This persists potentially sensitive content (raw prompts and responses) to the local database. It never leaves your machine, but anyone with local access can read it. Enable it only if you need it for debugging.

onboarding_chat.permission_banner: At the end of the conversation, Apollia will suggest a few permission rules tailored to your answers - each rule appears as a card you can approve or refuse.
onboarding_chat.wrapup_detail_finalized: The agent saved your profile and applied the permission rules you approved. You can now open Apollia and explore.
onboarding_chat.wrapup_detail_safety: If you answered the main questions, we can wrap this up.
onboarding_chat.no_llm_detail: Go back to the previous step to configure a local model or a cloud provider - the agent needs one to chat.
onboarding_chat.llm_starting_detail: The AI engine is registering your model. The conversation starts as soon as it is ready.
onboarding_chat.finish_early_hint_calibration: You can wrap up once the first questions are answered.
onboarding_chat.finish_early_hint_enrichment: Optional from here - skip the rest whenever you like.
onboarding_chat.finish_early_message: That's good for me, let's wrap up.

onboarding_permissions.title: Suggested permission rules
onboarding_permissions.subtitle_html: Based on your answers, Apollia suggests the rules below. Apply the ones you want, dismiss the rest - you can always edit them under Settings → Permissions.

onboarding_stt.hotkey_hint: Triggers voice dictation from anywhere in the app. Combine at least one modifier key (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Meta) with a regular key.
onboarding_stt.no_microphone: No microphone detected. Connect one to use voice dictation.

projects.title: Projects

projects.template_developer_desc: Pre-configures code-oriented context providers: git, file tree, APOLLIA.md.
projects.context_intro: Context providers feed every agent with live information about this project: git status, tree, internal rules, custom scripts. They are collected at every run.
projects.context_empty_desc: Add a provider to enrich the context handed to this project's agents.
projects.context_snapshot_empty: No provider applicable to the current directory.
projects.context_snapshot_cwd_hint: Collected from the process current working directory.

projects.provider_type_tree_desc: Workspace structure (up to N lines). Helps the agent navigate.
projects.provider_type_rules_desc: Automatically loads APOLLIA.md, .cursorrules, AGENTS.md or an equivalent rules file.
projects.provider_type_script_desc: Runs a shell script or binary that emits JSON on stdout.
projects.provider_type_style_desc: Automatically detects code style via LLM (language, conventions, formatting).
projects.provider_type_style_warning: Requires a configured LLM router; will be skipped otherwise.
projects.provider_pick_subtitle: Choose the type of provider to add to this project.
projects.provider_delete_confirm_message: Are you sure you want to delete provider "{name}"?

projects.no_match_hint: No project matches your search. Adjust or clear the filter.
projects.agents_hint: Attaching an agent groups it under this project and narrows the Tasks tab to its tasks. It does not change how the agent runs: project instructions, documents and context providers are injected into chats opened from this project, never into agent tasks.
projects.agents_all_attached: Every installed agent is already attached
projects.no_agents_desc: Attach an installed agent to group it under this project and follow its tasks from the Tasks tab.
projects.agent_not_installed: Agent not installed on this machine
projects.empty_documents_desc: Attach a text file so conversations opened from this project can read it.
projects.detach_document_confirm: Detach "{name}" from this project? The file stays on disk.

agents.title: Your first assistant is one install away
agents.description: Install a Python agent file or spin one up from a template. Apollia runs it locally, in its own sandbox - no cloud round-trip.

tasks.title: Your task feed is wide open
tasks.description: When an agent runs, its tasks land here - completions, failures, approvals, everything tracked and replayable.

triggers.title: Let your agents run on their own
triggers.description: Triggers launch tasks on a cron schedule, a file change, or a webhook. Declare them in apollia.toml or create one below.

chat.title: Start a conversation with your agents
chat.description: Ask a question, brainstorm, or hand off a task. Every message stays on your machine - local-first by design.

notifications.title: Silence is golden - until it isn't
notifications.description: Add a desktop or webhook channel so your agents can reach you when they need attention or finish a long run.

integrations.title: Connect your first tool
integrations.description: Apollia speaks MCP - browse the registry or plug in a custom server to extend your agents with file systems, APIs, and more.

scope.agent_desc: The current assistant will no longer ask.
scope.agent_desc_apollia: Apollia Chat (or the current agent) will no longer ask.
scope.project_desc: All assistants used in this project.
scope.project_unavailable: Unavailable - the session is not attached to any project.
scope.project_no_project: This session is not attached to any project.

chrome.exit_body: Your progress is kept. You can pick it up from this step in the Getting started band.

band.title: Getting started
band.subtitle: Five moves to learn what Apollia can do for you.
band.done_body: This band steps aside to give you the room back. You will find it again in Help.

chat.label: Converse
chat.hint: Ask a question, get a result

automate.label: Automate
automate.hint: Let a task run on its own
automate.cta: Let a task run on its own

compose.title: It starts here, and it stays on your machine
compose.body: Describe what you want in plain language, or start from one of the suggested templates. The language model runs on your own machine.

approval.title: Nothing happens without your go-ahead
approval.body: Allow once, refuse, or always allow within a scope you choose. Everything is revocable in Settings.

trace.title: What just happened is on the record
trace.body: Every tool call leaves a timestamped trace you can read back, and whose integrity you can verify.

surfaces.title: Your surfaces
surfaces.body: The left column holds everything Apollia can do. Nothing is buried in a menu.

palette.title: Everything is one keystroke away
palette.body: The command palette opens any page, runs an action, and finds a past conversation.

modes.title: Two levels of detail
modes.body: Operator keeps it essential. Builder opens traces, costs and permissions. Switch whenever you like.

inbox.title: You are the go-ahead
inbox.body: Sensitive actions stop here and wait for your decision. Nothing proceeds without you.

what.title: A project holds one topic
what.body: Conversations, documents and workspace in one place, so you stop re-explaining the context every time.

documents.title: The Context tab
documents.body: Standing instructions and project documents. Whatever you put here becomes readable by your assistants.

context.title: Your assistant reads it without being told again
context.body: The project content is genuinely attached to your exchanges. It is the most useful mechanism in Apollia, and the quietest.

create.title: Describe what you want
create.body: One sentence sets the frame. The parsing is deterministic: always read the proposed schedule back.

when.title: Choose when
when.body: Every morning, every thirty minutes, or once on a given date.

run_now.title: Run it now to check
run_now.body: The row menu fires the automation immediately instead of waiting for its next due time.

catalogue.title: The catalogue
catalogue.body: Ready-to-use MCP servers, and native connectors for your accounts. A local server plugs in with no account to create.

list.title: Your connections and their state
list.body: Each row shows whether the connection holds, what it exposes, and how long since it was last used.

capabilities.title: What the tool can do
capabilities.body: The detail pane lists the actions made available to your assistants once the connection is live.

timeline.title: Everything that happened, in order
timeline.body: Timeline, costs, audit journal, and the mailbox between assistants.

costs.title: What it cost you
costs.body: Usage per day and per model. Running locally costs nothing beyond your own machine.

journal.title: The journal, chained and tamper-evident
journal.body: Every tool call is cryptographically chained to the one before it. A line edited after the fact breaks the chain and becomes detectable.

help_topic.title: Revisit getting started
help_topic.body: Reopens the band and its five milestones on the dashboard.

stt_failure.nothing_audible: Nothing audible was captured. Check that the right microphone is selected and not muted.
